# Explicit market and currency regression sources

Immutable public official HTML captured on 2026-10-14 UTC / 2026-10-13 Vancouver.
`manifest.json`, the two loan manifests and `cards.json` record actual consulted
URLs, capture times and SHA256 of decompressed original bytes. No financial values
are supplied by operation scripts. Actual Run/storage/model mappings stay private.

Tests use independent expected native currencies, printed annual fees, complete
loan APR/repayment bounds and conditional exclusions. Card regressions use the
ordinary chunk builder, so applicability/payment notes cannot disappear across a
900-character split. Generic issuer mutations and missing/conflicting/masked,
foreign-origin, monthly-only and competing-product cases stay fail-closed.
